Define L_rec=(1/(|I|·3))Σ_{i∈I}Σ_{l=1}^3 D_c²(u_{i,l},q_{i,l}); define L_commit=(1/(|I|·3))Σ_{i∈I}Σ_{l=1}^3 D_c²(u_{i,l},sg(q_{i,l})); total L=L_rec+0.25L_commit+0.1L_trans.
